summary: Implemented the terminal window title feature. Changes: rich/segment.py (SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 added to ControlType; Tuple[ControlType, str] added to ControlCode union); rich/control.py (formatting entry emitting "\x1b]0;{title}\x07" and Control.title classmethod with docstring); rich/console.py (Console.set_window_title beside show_cursor, returns True when written and False when not a terminal, with Google-style docstring); rich/_windows_renderer.py (dispatch branch calling term.set_title(title)); CHANGELOG.md (Unreleased Added bullet linking pull request 2200); tests added in tests/test_console.py, tests/test_control.py, and tests/test_windows_renderer.py. Not run: tests, Black, and mypy, per instructions. Nothing committed. Notes: the renderer calls set_title because that is the existing Windows wrapper method name, not set-title as written in the spec; the CHANGELOG PR URL was inferred from the PR number.
